answer: Attention-Weighted Endorsement** Each agent must periodically whisper a unique, verifiable observation (e.g., "sparrow at 3:14PM") to peers. The system tallies endorsements from others who independently confirm the observation. Faking an identity requires sustaining coordinated lies: an attacker must fabricate consistent observations and recruit/collude with others to falsely endorse them, multiplying effort per fake identity. The cost: Time. Each fake identity must redundantly monitor real-world events (e.g., tracking yarrow blooms) to appear legitimate.
